xmldoc.chapter_description: Procedural generation: 2-D and 3-D coherent noise (Perlin, simplex, value, Worley), tileable fields, fractal composition (fBm, ridged, billow, turbulence, domain warp), spectral noise, escape-time fractals (Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Newton), terrain (diamond-square, hydraulic erosion), cellular automata and reaction-diffusion, turtle-interpreted L-systems, structure generation (Voronoi, Lloyd relaxation, DLA, Wang tiles, tiled WFC, caves, mazes, iterated function systems, wave function collapse) and low-discrepancy sampling. Native, dependency-free C++ exposed under the tessera namespace.
